Trace, implement and test: 面试题45. 把数组排成最小的数

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    string minNumber(vector<int>& nums) {
        vector<string> arr;
        for (int& x : nums) {
            arr.emplace_back(to_string(x));
        }
        sort(arr.begin(), arr.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
            return a + b < b + a;
        });
        string ans;
        for (auto& x : arr) {
            ans += x;
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
